purpose: Fixed teaching calculations and explicit gaps; not a live data product or independent validation of quoted site samples.

drag.assumptions: Circular speed; atmosphere rotation and winds omitted; quiet reference density has no epoch.

calculations.gps_l1: Range error = 40.3 * TEC / f^2; TEC = 1e16 electrons/m2; f = 1.57542e9 Hz; result approximately 0.1624 m.
calculations.adiabatic_energy: 10 keV * (8 / 4)^3 = 80 keV; ideal dipole adiabatic example, not all particle trajectories.
calculations.pressure: Proton dynamic pressure n*m_p*V^2 = 1.6726e-6*n_cm-3*V_km-s^2 nPa; helium excluded.
calculations.ground_track: 360 degrees * 94 min / 1436.068 min sidereal day = 23.56 degrees; the legacy 23.7-degree quote is rounded more coarsely than this calculation supports.
calculations.footprint: lambda = acos((R/(R+h))*cos(epsilon))-epsilon; R=6378.137 km, h=500 km; masks 0 and 10 degrees; compare spherical cap areas proportional to 1-cos(lambda).
calculations.orbit_speed: v=sqrt(mu/(R+h)); T=2*pi*sqrt((R+h)^3/mu); mu=398600 km3/s2 and R=6378 km for mechanism video examples.
